vulnerabilities.title: ENV=DEV default disables JWT -- all routes authenticated as super6@agi.com
vulnerabilities.details: check_auth() in superagi/helper/auth.py: 'env = get_config("ENV", "DEV"); if env == "PROD": Authorize.jwt_required()'. config_template.yaml ships ENV='DEV'. Any deployment copying config_template without setting ENV=PROD has zero authentication. get_current_user() returns hardcoded User(email='super6@agi.com') in DEV mode.

vulnerabilities.title: Static JWT signing key 'secret'
vulnerabilities.details: config_template.yaml: JWT_SECRET_KEY='secret'. In PROD mode this is the signing key for all issued tokens. Known value = arbitrary token forgery.

vulnerabilities.title: Static ENCRYPTION_KEY for at-rest tool API key storage
vulnerabilities.details: config_template.yaml: ENCRYPTION_KEY=abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz123456. All tool API keys (OpenAI, GitHub, Slack, Stability, Google, Jira, HuggingFace, Replicate) are encrypted with this key at rest in postgres. Default key = plaintext recovery without DB auth bypass.

vulnerabilities.title: Postgres default credentials superagi/password
vulnerabilities.details: docker-compose.yaml POSTGRES_USER=superagi / POSTGRES_PASSWORD=password / POSTGRES_DB=super_agi_main. Port 5432 commented out by default but frequently exposed in cloud deploys.

vulnerabilities.title: Wildcard CORS on FastAPI backend
vulnerabilities.details: main.py: CORSMiddleware allow_origins=['*'], allow_methods=['*'], allow_headers=['*']. Any origin can make cross-site requests to the API including in DEV-mode-bypass context.

auth_evidence: superagi/helper/auth.py check_auth(): 'env = get_config("ENV", "DEV"); if env == "PROD": Authorize.jwt_required()'. get_current_user(): 'if env == "DEV": email = "super6@agi.com"'. config_template.yaml: ENV='DEV'. Conclusion: default deploy = zero auth; all endpoints map to hardcoded user.
